title: Milgrom–Shannon's Monotonicity Theorem: the Full Characterization
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: Milgrom and Shannon (1994), Theorem 4, in both directions: for an arbitrary lattice X, partially ordered parameter space T, and real-valued objective, strong-set monotonicity of constrained maximizers over every pair of strongly ordered feasible subsets is equivalent to quasisupermodularity of every section and both weak and strict preference-preservation clauses of single crossing. The theorem imposes no finiteness, completeness, topology, continuity, compactness, nonemptiness, or optimizer existence assumptions. review.reason: Full characterization of Milgrom-Shannon monotonicity theorem for constrained maximizers, with supporting counterexamples.
